basic_info.description:
Welcome to 3338 17th Street, Unit 209 (modern apartment loft|top floor): In-unit washer and dryer, heating and air conditioning for year-round comfort, brand new LG stainless steel appliances, freshly painted interior, rooftop access with your own designated private area, 1.5 bathrooms, garage parking available - This beautiful loft apartment blends comfort with contemporary design, offering open-concept living with high ceilings and expansive windows that flood the space with natural light. 

This newly painted 1-bedroom loft apartment boasts a generous living area.

The lofted bedroom overlooks the living area and offers plenty of space for a king-sized bed and additional furnishings. A full bathroom upstairs and a half bath downstairs provide convenience for both residents and guests.
Located just steps from Valencia Street, known for its trendy boutiques, cafes, and restaurants, this home places you in the heart of one of San Francisco's most vibrant neighborhoods.

HIGHLIGHTS:
- Unfurnished, Top Floor Unit (virtually staged for inspiration)
- Garage parking available ($300 for 1 parking stall | $450 for 2 tandem parking spots | EV spots available at request)
- In-unit washer and dryer stacker
- Rooftop access with your own designated private area (virtually staged for inspiration)
- Newly painted
- Heating and air conditioning for year-round comfort
- Brand new LG stainless steel appliances: dishwasher, gas stove, microwave with vented hood
- 1.5 bathroom
- Water and trash included in rent
- Callbox system for indoor deliveries
- Pet friendly: 1 dog/cat is welcome 

PRIME LOCATION: 
This loft is in a prime San Francisco location, right next to Valencia Street with its vibrant mix of cafes, restaurants, and boutique shops. Enjoy the best of the Mission District lifestyle while still having quick access to public transit and major freeways for easy commuting.

PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION:
-Bryant St & 17th St (27 Bryant) about a 4-minute walk
The 27 Bryant bus runs north through SoMa, Civic Center, Tenderloin, and up to Jackson & Van Ness. It's a direct connection to downtown and northern neighborhoods.

-Folsom St & 18th St (12 Folsom-Pacific) about a 5-minute walk
The 12 Folsom-Pacific bus connects the Mission and SoMa to downtown, running along Folsom Street toward the Financial District in one direction, and south toward Cesar Chavez in the other.

-16th St. Mission BART Station about a 10-minute walk
Serviced by the Red, Yellow, Green, and Blue BART lines. Quick access to downtown San Francisco (Civic Center, Powell, Montgomery, Embarcadero), the East Bay (Oakland, Berkeley, Richmond), and direct service to SFO and Millbrae

NEARBY COFFEE SHOPS (All Within 10 Minutes Walk):
-Abanico Coffee Roasters (2121 Mission St, ~3 min walk)
 Known for Latin-American inspired drinks, small-batch roasts, and a cozy, welcoming space.

-Philz Coffee (1775 17th St, ~4 min walk)
 Famous for custom-blended drip coffees made to order; the Mint Mojito iced coffee is a local favorite.

-Four Barrel Coffee (375 Valencia St, ~6 8 min walk)
 Popular specialty roaster with excellent pour-overs, espresso drinks, and pastries.

-Sisters Coffee Shop (920 Valencia St, ~5 7 min walk)
 Locally owned by two sisters; serves organic, fair-trade coffee and house-made treats.

-Linea Caffe (3417 18th St, ~8 10 min walk)
 Known for strong espresso, fresh pastries, and a friendly neighborhood vibe.

-Ritual Coffee Roasters Mission (1026 Valencia St, ~7 min walk)
 Focuses on sustainable, ethically sourced beans with high-quality espresso and pour-overs.

TOP LOUNGES & COCKTAIL BARS NEARBY (All ~10 Minutes or Less on Foot):
-True Laurel (753 Alabama St, ~7-8 min walk)
 A stylish cocktail bar & restaurant opened by the Lazy Bear team; known for its inventive, sustainable cocktails using local flora, high quality bar food, and warm, buzzy atmosphere. 

-ABV (3174 16th St, ~8-10 min walk)
 Casual but refined cocktail bar with strong drink creativity, good small bites; great if you want a nice cocktail out without too much fuss. 

-The Beehive (842 Valencia St at 19th, ~8-9 min walk)
 Retro-styled cocktail lounge with mid-century charm; fun cocktails, vintage glassware, nice vibe for small groups or date nights. 

-Locanda (557 Valencia St, ~6-7 min walk)
 While it's primarily an Italian restaurant, the bar is highly regarded for its playful balanced cocktails and lively vibe; good option for dinner + drinks. 

-500 Club (Guerrero & 17th, ~4-5 min walk)
 Neighborhood dive-cocktail bar; relaxed, local, good place to unwind, music, cocktails and more casual atmosphere. 

LIVE MUSIC & NIGHTLIFE
-Brick & Mortar Music Hall (1710 Mission St, ~8-10 min walk)
 An independent live-music venue hosting bands and DJs across multiple genres, known for its energetic shows and intimate club atmosphere. 

-Echo SFC (2565 Mission St, ~10-12 min walk)
 High-energy nightclub with bi-level dance floors, DJs spinning hip hop, R&B, EDM; lots of late-night events and bottle service. 

-The Valencia Room (Valencia Street, Mission District, ~10-12 min walk depending on route)
 Music venue / nightclub space with live bands, DJ nights, and a full schedule of performances. 

-Slate Bar (in the Valencia / Mission area, ~10-12 min walk)
 Queer-friendly, intimate bar with DJs, live music, karaoke good for nights out when you want a more casual club vibe. 

-500 Club (Guerrero & 17th, ~4-5 min walk)
 Local crowd; more of a late-night bar that sometimes has a dance or DJ component; more relaxed than full-on clubs but very convenient for going out. 

PARKS
-In Chan Kaajal Park (17th & Folsom) (~3-4 min walk)
 A newer neighborhood park with a playground, community garden, picnic area, and public plaza. 

-Mission Dolores Park (~8-10 min walk)
 A large, 15-16 acre park featuring lawns, palm trees, tennis courts, basketball courts, playgrounds, off-leash dog areas, and great views of the city skyline. 

-Mission Playground Park (19th & Linda, bordering Valencia Street) (~5-7 min walk)
 Includes open lawn space, playground, pool, tennis and basketball courts, and fields for sports.

*Lease terms:
-12 month contract
-Water and trash included in rent: Paid by owner
-Gas and electric: Paid by tenant
-No smoking
-1 dog/cat is welcome
